Fig. 9. Lane predictions on six validation frames (conf ≥ 0.25). Three or four lanes are found per frame with confidences of roughly 0.73-0.93, and the masks follow the painted markings, including under overpass shadows and behind a truck. Large overlapping boxes are an artefact of diagonal, thin lanes.
Fig. 10. Detection predictions on six held-out test images (conf ≥ 0.25, NMS IoU 0.7), e.g. a cat at 0.91 confidence and buses at 0.94 and 0.86 with several partially occluded persons.
